items.title: Microsoft Viva: Access Management for Copilot Analytics
items.description: Admins can now manage who has access to Viva Insights - Copilot Analytics, and what they can do, directly in the product. The new Access Management experience brings role assignment and permissions into one place for Global administrators, AI administrators and Viva Insights administrators, instead of managing access across Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center and in-product Manager Settings. Admins create access policies that combine a permission set, which defines what users can do, with a partition, which defines the population and datasets users can see. Policies can be assigned to individual users, Microsoft Entra security groups or, for group managers, organizational attributes. Existing role assignments continue to work, and users are automatically moved to system-defined access policies.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
items.description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource .

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Agent onboarding for new employees
items.description: Business value Onboarding in Dynamics 365 Human Resources spans several pages and two people: HR administrators hire the candidate, enroll leave and set compensation, while the new employee completes personal details, address, emergency contacts and identification. Steps are easy to miss. A new agentic onboarding experience will brings the tasks into one guided conversation over live Human Resources data. Every change is previewed and confirmed explicitly, and all reads and writes run under the signed-in user's security roles and legal entities, so teams move faster without giving up control. Capability details Ready-to-start worklist: unprocessed candidates whose estimated start date falls in the configured trigger lead-days window, across the HR manager's legal entities. Guided hire: opens the standard Hire new worker dialog with real lookup values (worker type, employment type, dates, position, personnel number, checklist templates), then creates the worker and re-reads the result. Start date adjustment, leave plan enrollment and fixed compensation, each confirmed and read back, plus a read-only onboarding status view. New employee self-service: own checklist grouped overdue, pending and done, plus personal details, home address, emergency contacts and identification. Identification capture: the employee uploads a passport, license, national ID or work permit image; the agent proposes the type, number, issuing country and dates, masks the number and requires confirmation. The image is not retained. Also included: natural-language address entry, progress summary, an introductory email draft and resource links. Enablement Configured per legal entity in Human resources parameters: the Copilot HR manager toggle and Copilot trigger lead days drive the candidate worklist. Administrator capabilities require the Human resource manager or assistant role; employee capabilities run under self-service access

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Activity Approvals Agent
items.description: The Approvals Agent in Dynamics 365 Project Operations uses AI to perform an initial review of submitted time, expense, and material entries against policy documents written in natural language. It classifies entries as Ready for approval or Needs review, helping project managers prioritize entries that require attention. Organizations can choose between two operating modes. In Classify mode, approvers review the agent’s classifications and manually approve entries. In Classify and auto approve mode, entries classified as Ready for approval are automatically processed for approval, while entries classified as Needs review remain available for human review. Administrators can configure organization-wide policies and project-specific policies for each entry type. A project-specific policy takes precedence over the corresponding organization-wide policy. Project-level controls determine which projects use the agent, with a configurable default for new projects. Approvers can review classified entries, approve or reject them, or return them to the agent for reevaluation after a policy update. If no applicable policy document exists for an entry type, the agent does not classify those entries.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Customize how Recommended Actions are prioritized with custom instructions
items.description: Administrators can customize how the Recommended Actions agent prioritizes actions by configuring natural-language instructions for individual source agents. This gives organizations greater flexibility to align AI-generated recommendations with their sales strategies while retaining the built-in intelligence of the Recommended Actions experience. With this capability, administrators can: Define business-specific prioritization criteria : Use natural-language instructions to express the organization's priorities. For example, prioritize opportunities with a high revenue value that have passed their expected close date. **Configure prioritization by source agent: **Define separate instructions for supported source agents, such as Sales Opportunity Agent, Sales Qualification Agent, and custom agents. **- Map instructions to CRM data: **Associate custom prioritization instructions with relevant Dynamics 365 data, including both out-of-the-box and custom fields and entities. **- Combine custom business priorities with AI scoring: **Custom instructions complement the built-in prioritization criteria, which consider urgency, business impact, confidence, and effort when ranking recommended actions.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): The more you use Copilot in Office the better it gets
items.description: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Ask HR - conversational HR self-service grounded in your own worker record
items.description: Business value Employees and managers routinely contact HR for answers their HR system already holds — how much leave they have, what their policy allows in their location, where a request has reached. The information exists, but it is spread across separate records, so a generic answer is often wrong for the individual asking. Workforce intelligence answers those questions from the person's own worker record, plan enrolment and jurisdiction, and lets them complete the related transaction in the same conversation, so routine requests are resolved directly and HR teams can focus on work that needs judgment. Capability details Personal information, viewed and maintained: Employees can view their own personal details and submit updates, with the change written back through the standard governed process. Grounded policy and HR answers: Questions are answered from the employee's own plan, grade and jurisdiction rather than a single generic policy response. Leave entitlement and requests: Employees can ask about entitlement and balance, submit a leave request, and check the status of a request they already raised. Manager approvals: Managers can review their pending queue and act on requests for their direct reports. Team availability: Managers can ask about coverage across their direct reports. Governed by design: Requests operate on a bounded context — the individual and their direct relationships — and the agent confirms an action with the user before any record is written. Enablement Enablement details, including administrator setup, prerequisites and rollout behavior, will be confirmed before release.

items.title: Work IQ: Listen
items.description: Enable agents to listen for supported Work IQ events and respond as relevant changes occur.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
items.description: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center. Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn , providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released. These reports can be used with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent - Sensitive Data Remediation through Microsoft Teams
items.description: The Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention now offers a new sensitive data remediation function, which empowers organizations to proactively identify and remediate sensitive information—such as Social Security Numbers, passwords, and credit card data—across thousands of files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive locations, dramatically increasing the percentage of remediated files with sensitive information, resulting in reduced compliance risk. Seamlessly integrated with Microsoft Purview, this new agent function automatically detects file(s) with a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy match “Needs Attention” alerts and pushes a remediation notification to the end user who last modified the file guiding them to remove sensitive data through targeted Microsoft Teams messages. Its’ closed-loop workflow ensures that remediation progress is tracked and confirmed, giving admins real-time visibility and control via the Data Security Posture Management dashboard. By streamlining sensitive data cleanup and automating user engagement, this agent helps organizations achieve their remediation goals at scale. Let the Data Security Triage Agent handle the heavy lifting of pushing remediation requests directly to the end user, so Purview admins don't have to!

items.title: Power Apps: Expand model access and Maker Studio availability for generative pages via GitHub
items.description: Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience. This integration also brings Maker Studio generative page authoring to regions without dedicated Power Apps GPU capacity. Model availability through GitHub may evolve over time, and requests made through this connection consume the maker’s GitHub credits. Availability Field Value Release Channel Not applicable Applies to Model-driven apps Feature Scope Admins or makers

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing software investments and unlocks more surfaces for the tools their users already rely on.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
items.description: The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle. Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing. File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML). Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
items.description: The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs. Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents. Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps. Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.description: Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it. Share from the workflows page or the designer. Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing. See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share. Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.description: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
items.description: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: D365 Contact Center Admin Center users can create CCI agents
items.description: Use the customer conversation harness agent builder to create, test, and refine AI-powered customer service agents. Accelerate agent development with built-in tools for conversation design, orchestration, evaluation, and deployment across customer engagement channels.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Copilot to make on canvas edits on Pages
items.description: Bring Copilot into the flow of collaboration on your Page, not just the chat box. Leave comments on your Page to ask Copilot questions or request targeted edits directly, and have people and Copilot work across the Page while seeing their presence and changes

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
items.description: Turn ideas and source material into rich, interactive reports and dashboards with Pages. Start with a prompt and bring together content, visuals, charts, and interactive elements in one shareable Page where you can work with your collaborators and agents. Edit content on the Page directly just like any other Microsoft 365 file.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Customer Context
items.description: Sellers and service reps lose time piecing together a customer picture from tabs, records, and reports, and still miss the signals that matter. Account and Contact 360 delivers one AI-powered view of every account and contact, with relationship, engagement, and opportunity insights and recommended next steps. It works wherever people work: in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and in Microsoft 365 through the Sales and Service agents and Cowork. Admins tailor insights to their own data and terminology, with no custom code.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Service Agent in Microsoft 365 - your dedicated service specialist
items.description: • Rapid onboarding to a hybrid workforce:Service Agent in Microsoft 365 can be hired and onboard with your company's knowledge sources, communication guidelines and escalation rules etc. in minutes. Manager can choose the semi or full autonomous mode. • 24/7 support: Natively connects to Microsoft 365 ecosystem, accessing real-time data, documents, CRM records and thousands of knowledge connectors. Handles customer inquiries 24/7 with consistent quality and context, improving resolution rates and customer satisfaction over time. • Secure and Compliant: Built from A365 platform and natively leverage WorkIQ, Service Agent in Microsoft 365 has both the intelligence of customer’s enterprise knowledge and enterprise-grade identity, be secure and compliant. • Agent observability - full transparency and visibility: Managers can monitor the Service Agent's activities and drill through to see the reasoning (why it answers in this way); they can also see the performance metrics. • CRM agnostic: CRM is not a prerequisite to use Service Agent in Microsoft 365. We treat CRMs as tools; customers can choose to connect to their CRMs to create a ticket or other operations. • Extensibility: Service Agent can connect to various MCP tools and you are also allowed to create custom skills and capabilities rather than just use the out of box ones.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use after conversation presence status for wrap-up activities
items.description: After conversation work presence is a system-generated status that's automatically set when a customer service representative is finishing tasks after a customer interaction, such as writing notes, updating records, selecting dispositions, or completing follow-up actions. Instead of showing the representative as Busy or Do Not Disturb (DND), the system displays one of the following dedicated statuses: Busy – After Conversation Work DND – After Conversation Work The system automatically sets the status based on the administrator configuration for the workstream in Copilot Service admin center. Always block : Representatives remain unavailable until they close the session. Custom time : Representatives remain unavailable for a configured time period. Don't block : No routing restrictions during wrap-up. The representative can't change the status. After the feature is enabled, supervisors can view and filter representatives based on the after conversation work presence statuses.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan accounts from Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork with Sales Research Agent
items.description: Sellers can draft, review, and work their Dynamics 365 Sales account plans from Cowork. Sales Research Agent brings the same account-planning experience - objectives, targets, actions, and gaps grounded in CRM data - into the place sellers already work, and changes are saved to the plan in Dynamics 365 Sales.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan your sales portfolio with Sales Research Agent
items.description: Portfolio planning is an AI-first capability in Sales Research Agent that turns CRM data, lakehouse signals (such as budgets, targets, usage, billing, and adoption), and web context into a continuously updated plan across accounts, segments, and partners. What's new You can run scenario-driven planning for the most common field workflows: Account executive overview to understand the current state across accounts. Deal rescue to identify and unblock stalled opportunities. Renewal risk and expansion to protect revenue first, then grow. Segment and industry performance to determine where to invest. Plans refresh automatically as signals change, so they stay current instead of aging out after quarterly business reviews (QBRs) or annual planning. You also get explainable recommendations showing the drivers behind prioritization and actions (the "why this" behind every recommendation). How it works Portfolio planning combines three classes of signals to maintain an always-current decision view: Intent signals (CRM) : Pipeline, activities, stage history Reality signals (OneLake) : Budgets, targets, usage trends, billing, cost-to-value indicators Context signals (web and internal) : Organizational changes, strategic priorities, competitive moves, macro events The agent synthesizes these signals into a clear decision flow: What changed : Signals and anomalies So what : Impact on pipeline, renewals, budgets, and targets Now what : Actionable recommendations

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Create custom blueprints in Sales Research Agent
items.description: Blueprint Builder lets makers define a reusable, AI-driven planning experience in Sales Research Agent - the starter prompt, sections, data sources, narratives, and visualizations - and save it as a custom blueprint that runs across every account, portfolio, and territory. What's new Author a blueprint as an ordered layout of blocks: narrative sections, visualizations, data-driven areas, and deep-research areas. Ground each block in Dataverse, Dynamics 365 Sales, Fabric Lakehouse, or a business function. Generate, refine, publish, and share blueprints across teams.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Build business functions for Sales Research Agent
items.description: A business function gives Sales Research Agent the context and instructions it needs for a specific use case, such as account planning, territory planning, pipeline review, or engagement analysis. Business Function Builder creates that configuration from your data, schema metadata, and optional reference content, so you don't author every field by hand. What's new Create a business function from a natural-language description of your use case. Let the agent discover the relevant tables (including custom tables), columns, and relationships. Evaluate the business function against your real data, with graded test questions that show where it's wrong and why. Promote test questions to starter prompts, and give each one a default blueprint so every user gets the same answer shape from their own data. Share a validated business function with users and roles in your organization.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan Accounts with Sales Research Agent
items.description: Account planning gives sellers one place in Dynamics 365 Sales to decide what they want to achieve with an account, how they'll get there, and how they're tracking against it. The plan lives next to the account, reads live from CRM data, and moves through review and approval before it becomes the active plan for the period. What's new Draft with Sales Research Agent. The agent reads the account, its opportunities, seller notes, growth plays, and wallet sizes, then proposes objectives, targets, and actions with its reasoning. Nothing becomes part of the plan until the seller accepts it. Objectives, targets, and actions. Targets roll up to objectives, and progress is calculated from linked opportunities and activities, not typed in. Wallet share, stakeholders, competitors, and growth plays on the plan, kept current from CRM. Approval. Sellers submit the plan to an approver; changes to an approved plan go live only after they're approved again. Plan the next period by completing a plan and carrying objectives forward.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: usage-based billing for agents and features
items.description: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence uses consumption-based billing for AI-powered interactions. Usage generated by voice and digital agents is metered and billed based on actual consumption, including AI model processing, tool usage, orchestration, and related AI services. Usage is attributed to your organization and charged through your configured billing enrollment, enabling transparent cost tracking and pay-for-what-you-use pricing. Authorized users can view usage details, monitor consumption trends, and download reports for cost management and analysis.

items.title: Work IQ: Dynamic skills
items.description: Enable agents to select and use the most relevant skills dynamically for each request.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan and rebalance territories with Sales Research Agent
items.description: Territory planning in Sales Research Agent helps sales leaders and sales operations decide where to focus coverage. It combines CRM pipeline and activity with signals such as targets, account potential, and capacity to show how each territory is performing and where to rebalance. What's new See territory performance against targets, with the drivers behind each gap. Get recommendations on which accounts to prioritize or deprioritize, and where coverage or capacity is out of balance. Plans refresh as signals change, so territory decisions don't wait for the annual planning cycle.

items.title: Work IQ: Granular MCP policies
items.description: Provide granular policies that restrict MCP access to trusted platforms, workloads, and supported operations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Biometric authentication and fraud detection
items.description: Together, voice biometric authentication and fraud detection deliver business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers (note: these two capabilities can be used independently or together). Voice biometric authentication allows organisations to authenticate callers from their voice during natural conversations. It helps improve identity assurance, shortens call durations, reduces customer service rep effort and facilitates secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it helps improve scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This helps organisations enable consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity. Fraud detection allows organisations to create fraud watchlists, screen incoming calls and generate real-time alerts when a potential fraud match is detected.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Protect sensitive data across agent-to-human and agent-to-tool interactions with expanded DLP controls across local agents
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now expands inline protection to supported local AI agents, helping safeguard sensitive data across human-to-agent and agent-to-tool interactions. Organizations can apply DLP policies to prompts, files, and tool interactions to block policy-violating data movement at supported interaction points. These controls help prevent sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users’ behalf.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces - Updated workspace memory
items.description: With Work IQ, Copilot can now retain useful context from how you work in a workspace so future responses are more relevant, consistent, and personalized. Copilot can use saved memory such as workspace details, working preferences, and recurring instructions to reduce repeated setup and help you continue work more efficiently across workspace sessions.

items.title: Power Apps: Build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
items.description: Information workers can now use model-app-builder skill in Copilot Cowork to create and refine model-driven apps from natural-language requirements. Cowork turns a business scenario into an app specification and build plan for review before creating the model-driven app and its supporting Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse artifacts. By handling repetitive artifact creation, makers can move from an idea to a working app fast and spend more time refining the app's design and business experience. Makers can continue iterating through conversation in Cowork or open the generated artifacts in Power Apps for direct customization. Availability Field Value Release Channel Not applicable Applies to Model-driven apps Feature Scope Admins or makers

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: An agentic home for all sales AI
items.description: When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard. Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together, giving sellers one place to understand what needs attention and what to do next without navigating separate agent experiences or working out the right prompt. From this home, sellers can review prioritized recommendations and next steps from their agents, prepare for upcoming customer meetings, and review past meetings when the required meeting information is available. Sellers can understand the context behind their work and move from an insight to the next action in their selling workflow.

items.title: Power Automate: Self-healing
items.description: Self-healing is an agentic feature that improves the resilience of desktop flows by recovering from UI or web automation failures. When an existing selector can no longer locate the intended UI element, Power Automate for desktop uses AI to identify the element and generate an alternative selector. The preview phase includes an action-level opt-in option for automatically trying to recover from a selector error, while the GA phase will additionally include a flow-level opt-in option to only log the alternative, working selector in case of an error, without applying the fix during runtime.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI and Copilot Upskilling Nudges in Microsoft Teams by Learning Agent
items.description: Learning Agent proactively delivers personalized AI and Copilot upskilling notifications through Microsoft Teams, helping users discover relevant learning opportunities in their flow of work. These notifications are tailored to users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns, guiding them toward practical scenarios and skills they can apply in everyday tasks.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Coaching and development
items.description: Coaching & development extends the Quality Evaluation Agent from identifying quality gaps to closing them. It turns insights into scorecards, coaching and targeted training, then measures whether representatives improve.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent 365 Business Analytics experience
items.description: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going, what value it’s delivering, and where to invest next. Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users, understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates, and forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Work IQ Real Time Transcription for Meetings and Calls
items.description: Work IQ enables authorized applications and AI agents to access transcript content from supported Microsoft Teams meetings and calls as conversations unfold. Through Model Context Protocol (MCP), developers can combine live conversation context with business data to build experiences such as contextual recommendations, customer-support assistance, action-item capture, and workflow automation—without waiting for a post-meeting transcript. The capability uses an active Teams transcript feed and requires applicable permissions and consent; it does not automatically start transcription.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Code
items.description: Copilot Code is a new AI-powered coding experience in Microsoft Copilot that helps people turn ideas into working software, starting from the work they already do and building through natural language, grounded in their work by Work IQ. Projects can be published as managed apps on Copilot Managed Runtime with IT in control, and can optionally extend when connected to GitHub repositories and pull requests for review and further development.

items.title: Word: legal plugin
items.description: Understand, summarize, edit, review and draft legal documents with Copilot in Word.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
items.description: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant admin consent needed to use CRM notes. Only notes added by users with a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license are used, and Dataverse search is needed only for emails and Teams meetings, since notes are already linked to their records. These control toggles are available automatically. Admins can turn each source on or off in the Agent behavior section of the Data Enrichment settings. Outlook emails and Teams meetings stay off until their permissions are connected, and connecting a permission never turns a source on by itself. For organizations already using the agent, CRM notes is off by default and a banner lets admins know it's available. For new organizations, CRM notes is on by default. Availability Field Value Release Channel Weekly Version 2610.4 Applies to Model-driven apps Feature Scope Admins or makers

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Fill forms faster with Autofill - Auto paste
items.description: Save time entering information into Business Central with Auto paste. Building on Autofill, Auto paste uses AI to identify relevant information from text or HTML copied to your clipboard and map it to the appropriate fields on a Business Central page. Benefits Reduce manual data entry when bringing information from external sources into Business Central. Populate multiple relevant fields from copied content instead of copying and pasting individual values. Extend AI-assisted data entry to more everyday Business Central workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search
items.description: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Discover and act on recommended lead and opportunity actions in Sales agent
items.description: Sellers can discover and act on lead and opportunity recommendations that are already prioritized for them in Sales agent. A single prioritized list helps sellers see what needs attention without monitoring each agent separately or prioritizing the actions themselves. Sellers can review each recommended action, understand its details and business context, and take action from the same experience. The initial release focuses on lead outreach actions from Sales qualification agent and opportunity risk actions from Sales opportunity agent. Sellers can discover leads that need outreach and opportunities that need attention, review the recommended next step and its context, and act to move customer conversations and opportunities forward. Recommended actions will be turned on by default. Additional agents, including custom agents, are a future direction and are not part of this initial release commitment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality Evaluation Agent - Review historical quality metrics in a unified dashboard
items.description: The quality evaluation historical dashboard provides aggregated insights from completed evaluations, helping organizations track quality trends over time. Users can view quality scores and trends across selected date ranges, with up to two years of historical data available.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.description: Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply. Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes. When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents
items.description: Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description: We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation. The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment. The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description: Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records. Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model. For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Commerce MCP Tools for POS Shift and Cash Management
items.description: This feature provides reusable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for Store Commerce shift and cash management, exposing Commerce capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and developers can compose into agentic experiences. The tools enable agentic experiences to list a store's registers and drawers; scan current shift status, including open, suspended, blind-closed, and invalid shifts; list shifts opened in a requested period, including those now closed; retrieve structured detail for one shift, covering lifecycle, operational, tender, cash, tax, and transaction totals; return X-report content for an open shift and Z-report content for a closed shift; open one shift on the signed-in worker's register; blind close, fully close, or declare counted tenders and then close an eligible shift; record a starting amount, float entry, tender removal, or tender declaration; and review, reconcile, or undo cash reconciliation records. Shift detail and X-report content are available while a shift is still open, so a host experience can apply its own thresholds to what is returned and alert a manager during trading rather than after close. All operations execute through existing Commerce shift, cash, and permission logic. Responses return structured data hosts can present as status, cash positions, blockers, and next steps. Setup is performed by an administrator or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent to call the tools from an authenticated Point of Sale session, and maintain existing drawer assignments, cash policy, and Point of Sale permissions in Commerce headquarters.

items.title: Work IQ: Execute (Recipes)
items.description: Enable agents to execute reusable Work IQ recipes that coordinate supported tools and actions.

items.title: Work IQ: Federated connectors
items.description: Enable Work IQ to use federated connectors for governed access to additional enterprise data sources.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

items.title: OneDrive: Command-line tool for the OneDrive sync app
items.description: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line. Commands cover sync status, accounts, configuration, policies, and managing the sync app. JSON output lets scripts, management tools and AI agents automate these tasks.

items.title: Work IQ: Memory capabilities expand to agents
items.description: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC and GCC High
items.description: We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H). Availability differs for a small number of capabilities by cloud, as noted below. • Eligible users will see updated Insights app features and supported Insights Admin Center experiences. • Adoption and Impact experiences will include supported Copilot usage and impact measures, group and app views, trends, and filters. • Analysts will gain access to additional Advanced Analysis reports and queries. Supported users will also have sharing, delegation, and report-publishing capabilities. Cloud-specific differences • GCC only: Adoption by app for Edge and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. • GCC High: Impact supports scope, organization, and time-period filters, but not license, job-function, or usage-level filters. Creating an analysis excludes Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Microsoft 365): Accounting skills
items.description: Streamline corporate accounting work New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork help accountants spend less time on repetitive, manual tasks in the places they already work, including: • Reconcile accounts with confidence: Compare balances and transactions, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciling items for review. • Prepare journal entries faster: Draft accruals, reclassifications, allocations, reversals, and recurring entries, with checks for required inputs and balanced entries. • Turn results into clear reporting: Analyze financial performance against plan, identify key drivers, and prepare reporting that explains what changed and why. Additional capabilities span audit, tax, FP&A, compliance, and training. Learn more about the full set of accounting capabilities here. Accountants are already putting these capabilities to work. In seven days of limited Insiders availability, more than 8,000 unique users invoked accounting skills over 44,000 times across more than 18,000 Copilot conversations. Across Excel and Cowork, finance professionals will also have the option to start an audit trail whenever they invoke an accounting capability. If selected, this will create a record in their chat history of what Copilot changed and why. This is available today in Excel and coming soon to Cowork.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - specify when receipts must contain a VAT number
items.description: Help ensure expense receipts include required company VAT information by applying your organization’s receipt validation rules. Expense Agent can check submitted receipts for a valid company VAT number (Tax ID) when your configured rules require one, and flag receipts for review or prevent them from moving forward based on your policies. Benefits • Configure when a company VAT number is required on submitted expense receipts. • Automatically validate required VAT information during expense processing. • Identify receipts that do not meet configured tax identification requirements and handle them according to your policies.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
items.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules to make it easier for users to enter in large volumes
items.description: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules. Allow users to pre-select Tables and Fields at Group level that will be populated on every rules. If a Table key field like Product ID is included in the rules, then auto fill related fields with values like Product Name, Product Group etc. Support for Phase In a new Product with out pointing to and old Product. Support Delete of a Dimension or Dimension combination so it no longer appear in timeseries Investigate if rules can be created via Copilot - Cowork

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
items.description: Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations. The Screen layout designer is modernized as a React-based web experience embedded in Commerce headquarters, with a JSON-based layout backbone replacing the legacy XML representation. The feature applies to Store Commerce point of sale (POS). The modernization includes these core capabilities: Visual layout and button-grid authoring: Arrange and resize supported POS components on a drag-and-drop canvas, configure properties, and edit associated button grids and POS operation mappings in a unified experience. Live preview: Inspect layouts and their associated button-grid operations while designing, and preview supported device sizes and orientations without distributing every design iteration to stores. Existing layout migration: Bring existing screen layouts and button-grid configurations into the modern designer rather than recreate them from scratch. Reusable configuration: Reuse layout templates with store-specific overrides to reduce the need to maintain duplicate layouts. Modern usability: Work with contextual properties, familiar Fluent UI controls, and inline validation. Administrators enable or disable the modern designer through feature management in headquarters. Authorized users open Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Screen layouts , select a layout, and open the designer. They configure the layout and button grids, inspect the preview, and save changes to headquarters. Administrators distribute the saved configuration to stores through the existing Commerce data distribution process. Previewing changes does not replace the distribution needed to update Store Commerce. Setup is performed by a Commerce administrator, who enables the feature, grants appropriate headquarters permissions, and manages layout assignments and distribution. No separate ClickOnce designer installation or Copilot license is required for manual design.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: USA - Automate employee payments with ACH bank integration
items.description: Organizations in the United States can simplify employee expense reimbursements by paying approved claims directly to employees’ bank accounts through ACH. When used with the Expense Agent, approved reimbursements can be processed automatically, reducing manual payment handling and helping employees get reimbursed faster and more accurately.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use tags to mark processed emails
items.description: Quickly see which expense-related emails have already been processed by Expense Agent, helping you distinguish processed from unprocessed messages with confidence. Expense Agent adds a **Processed by Expense Agent **tag in Outlook after a relevant email has been successfully processed. Benefits • Automatically marks successfully processed expense-related emails. • Provides a clear processing-status indicator in Outlook, reducing the need to verify status manually. • Makes it easier to distinguish processed from unprocessed expense-related emails.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Adding invited guests from calendar as participants to your expense
items.description: Spend less time manually adding attendees to meal-related business expenses. Expense Agent can match the expense to the relevant Outlook calendar event and add invited guests as expense participants, helping keep participant information aligned with the meeting invitation. Benefits • Automatically identifies relevant Outlook calendar meetings when expense participants are required. • Retrieves invited attendees from the matching calendar invitation. • Adds invited guests as expense participants without manual entry.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Change companies and environments in the web app
items.description: Manage expenses across multiple Business Central companies and environments more efficiently with the Expense Agent web app. Switch between the companies and environments you’re authorized to access within a single session, without restarting the app or signing in again. Benefits • Access multiple authorized Business Central environments from the Expense Agent web app. • Switch directly between companies while managing expenses. • Reduce context switching when working across multiple organizations, business units, or legal entities.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Set expense spend limits in Expense Management
items.description: Take control of employee spending earlier in the expense process with configurable spend limits. Define thresholds that reflect your organization’s expense policies and apply them by time period for individual employees, teams, or the whole company. Expenses that exceed predefined limits can be prevented or flagged, with immediate feedback during expense creation. Benefits • Proactively manage expenses before reimbursement and accounting processes begin. • Reduce approval rework by giving employees immediate feedback when expenses exceed defined thresholds. • Support budget adherence across employees, teams, and the organization with configurable spending limits.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add tags for expenses as submitter
items.description: Make expenses easier to organize and categorize by adding relevant tags when you create or edit expenses in the web application. Add one or more custom tags to capture business, project, event, or other dimensional context beyond standard expense fields. Benefits • Add one or more custom tags while creating or editing an expense. • Capture relevant business, project, event, or other dimensional context with expense records. • Organize and categorize expenses beyond standard expense fields.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Enable approving limits and alternate approvers when primary is not available
items.description: Keep expense approvals moving when primary approvers are unavailable or when requests exceed their approval limits. Organizations can set a maximum approval amount—or unlimited approval authority—for each approver, designate a next approver for requests above that limit, and assign alternate approvers as temporary or scheduled backups. Approval requests can route to an alternate approver during periods of unavailability while following the same approval processes and controls. Benefits • Set approval limits for each approver and route requests that exceed those limits to a designated next approver. • Assign alternate approvers for ad hoc needs or planned periods of absence to help maintain approval continuity. • Reduce delays for employees submitting expenses by keeping approval requests moving when the primary approver is unavailable.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense with no attachment
items.description: Save time when recording lower-value expenses by creating them in Expense Agent without an attachment when the amount is below the limit you set on the Expense Agent Setup page. This gives you the flexibility to record qualifying expenses even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available. Benefits • Create qualifying expenses without requiring an attachment at the time of submission. • Set the amount limit that determines when an attachment isn’t required. • Record expenses below the configured limit even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Log the expense in a case of lost receipt
items.description: Expense Agent helps employees keep expense submissions moving when an original receipt is unavailable. It guides employees through providing the information needed to support the expense, generates supporting documentation from those details, and enables them to continue the reimbursement process without manually creating replacement documentation. Benefits • Provides a guided process for documenting expenses when receipts are lost or unavailable. • Reduces manual effort by automatically generating supporting documentation from employee-provided information. • Creates a more consistent lost-receipt process for employees and finance teams.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Split your expenses
items.description: Split a single expense across multiple allocations so costs are accurately assigned to the appropriate expense user, project, department, customer, or expense category. Expense Agent helps you define the split and ensures the allocations add up to the original expense amount. Each allocation is recorded separately for reporting and accounting while remaining linked to the original expense. Benefits • Accurately distribute expenses across multiple users, projects, departments, customers, or expense categories. • Define expense splits with help from Expense Agent while keeping allocations aligned with the original expense total. • Maintain separate allocation records for reporting and accounting while preserving the connection to the original expense.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Autonomously generate quotes and drive sales with Sales Development Agent
items.description: Sales Development Agent (SDA) can take leads from qualified opportunities to closed deals. Key capabilities include: Generating quotes through D365S as well as 1P/3P systems and sharing them with customers to company branded templates. Connectivity to quoting and transaction systems managed through Agent 365 MCP registry. Answer questions about the quote and adjust details based on customer feedback. Facilitate customers completing self-service transactions. Escalating to human sellers when customers are blocked and need human intervention. Configuration through interactive chat experience with each agent instance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Connectors, and Agents for US Government customers
items.description: We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments. These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description: We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center. With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase. Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into cost management and agent registry for AI services and agents built on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio agents).
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Biometric authentication
items.description: Voice biometric authentication delivers business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers. Voice-based verification improves identity assurance shortens call durations reduces customer service rep effort and enable secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it improves customer experience and scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This enables consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expenses from credit card feeds
items.description: Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include: Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps. Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions. Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable. Reduce duplicate data entry by leveraging transaction details already captured from credit card feeds. Credit card transactions are manually imported into the Credit Cards Feeds from the file. The system processes the imported transactions and identifies transactions eligible for expense creation. Expense Agent creates draft expenses using transaction information such as merchant, date, and amount. You can review the suggested expenses, and complete any required information before you submit. Matching capabilities help associate imported transactions with existing expenses, which helps avoid duplicates and improves reconciliation.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Universal connector for self-service omnichannel agents
items.description: Bring Microsoft AI to the contact center platform of your choice with the Universal Connector. Organizations can now integrate Microsoft self-service voice and chat agents with virtually any contact center using a simple API-based approach. The Universal Connector enables seamless handoff from AI agents to human representatives while preserving the full conversation context, ensuring a connected and personalized customer experience across every interaction. This flexibility allows organizations to modernize at their own pace by bringing AI-powered experiences to their existing contact center investments without requiring a costly migration or platform replacement. Whether supporting voice or chat experiences, customers can quickly extend intelligent self-service capabilities while maintaining continuity across AI and human-assisted engagements.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Tools
items.description: Tools are building blocks that let your agent interact with external systems. Tools expand what your agent can do, and your agent can perform various actions in response to user requests or autonomous triggers. Each tool represents a specific capability that your agent can perform. For example, you can equip your agent with tools that perform tasks like: Send emails by using the Office 365 Outlook connector Check the current weather conditions and forecasts Read and write data from Dataverse Read and post messages to Teams

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Historical analytics
